narrative:
Pickaway County has 38,273 registered voters, with 18.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 43.5%, a clear Democratic lean of 10.8 percentage points. Millennials are the largest generational cohort at 27.1% of registrants.
